Title: Create Part with only the required field
Preconditions: Valid API token; InvenTree instance reachable
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/ with only 'name' set 2) Inspect response
Expected Result: 201 Created; response body conforms to Part schema; 'name' persisted; default values (active=true, locked=false, default_expiry=0) applied

Title: Create Part with full writable attributes
Preconditions: Valid API token; a Category and Location already exist
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/ with name, IPN, revision, keywords, units, category, default_location, notes set 2) Inspect response
Expected Result: 201 Created; every supplied value is returned unchanged in the response and persists on a subsequent GET

Title: Retrieve Part by ID
Test Steps: 1) GET /api/part/{id}/ 2) Inspect response
Expected Result: 200 OK; 'pk' and 'name' match the created Part; response conforms to Part detail schema

Title: Retrieve Part with category and path detail flags
Preconditions: Part created in API-PART-002 exists, assigned to a Category
Test Steps: 1) GET /api/part/{id}/?category_detail=true&path_detail=true 2) Inspect response
Expected Result: 200 OK; response contains 'category_detail' and 'category_path' keys with the expected category business data

Title: PATCH updates only the supplied field
Preconditions: Part exists with a known 'name' and 'description'
Test Steps: 1) PATCH /api/part/{id}/ with only 'description' set 2) GET the Part again
Expected Result: 200 OK; 'description' is updated; 'name' and all other previously-set fields remain unchanged; change persists on GET

Title: PUT replaces the Part with a full valid payload
Test Steps: 1) PUT /api/part/{id}/ with a complete valid replacement payload (name, description, category, default_location) 2) Inspect response
Expected Result: 200 OK; response reflects the full replacement; server-managed fields (pk, creation_date) are unchanged

Title: PUT without required 'name' is rejected
Test Steps: 1) PUT /api/part/{id}/ with 'name' omitted 2) GET the Part again
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request; error payload references the missing 'name' field; a subsequent GET shows the Part's 'name' is unchanged (not corrupted)

Title: Read-only fields cannot be modified via PATCH
Test Steps: 1) PATCH /api/part/{id}/ attempting to set 'pk' to a different value alongside a valid 'description' change 2) Inspect response
Expected Result: 200 OK (valid fields applied) or 400 (rejected); in either case the Part's 'pk' remains server-managed and is never overwritten

Title: Delete an inactive Part succeeds
Preconditions: Part exists and is set active=false
Test Steps: 1) PATCH /api/part/{id}/ {"active":false} 2) DELETE /api/part/{id}/ 3) GET /api/part/{id}/
Expected Result: PATCH returns 200; DELETE returns 204 No Content; subsequent GET returns 404 Not Found

Title: Deletion of an active Part is blocked
Test Steps: 1) DELETE /api/part/{id}/ 2) GET /api/part/{id}/
Expected Result: DELETE returns a 4xx client error; the Part remains retrievable afterward (GET returns 200)

Title: Deletion of a locked Part is blocked
Test Steps: 1) PATCH /api/part/{id}/ {"locked":true} 2) DELETE /api/part/{id}/ 3) GET /api/part/{id}/
Expected Result: PATCH returns 200; DELETE returns a 4xx client error; the Part remains retrievable afterward

Title: Create Category with only the required field
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/category/ with only 'name' set 2) Inspect response
Expected Result: 201 Created; response conforms to Category schema; 'name' persisted; 'parent' is null; 'level' is 0

Title: Create a child Category under an existing parent
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/category/ with 'name' and 'parent'=<parent id> 2) GET the created category
Expected Result: 201 Created; 'parent' matches the supplied id; 'pathstring' includes both parent and child names

Title: Retrieve Category by ID
Test Steps: 1) GET /api/part/category/{id}/
Expected Result: 200 OK; 'pk' matches; response conforms to Category detail schema

Title: PATCH updates a Category's description
Test Steps: 1) PATCH /api/part/category/{id}/ {"description":"<unique>"} 2) GET the category
Expected Result: 200 OK; 'description' updated and persists on GET

Title: PUT replaces a Category with a full valid payload
Test Steps: 1) PUT /api/part/category/{id}/ with a full replacement (name, description) 2) Inspect response
Expected Result: 200 OK; 'pk' unchanged; 'name' and 'description' reflect the replacement

Title: PUT without required 'name' is rejected
Test Steps: 1) PUT /api/part/category/{id}/ with 'name' omitted
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request; error identifies the missing 'name' field

Title: DELETE without cascade flags is rejected
Test Steps: 1) DELETE /api/part/category/{id}/ with an empty body
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request; error payload requires 'delete_parts' and 'delete_child_categories' to be explicitly supplied

Title: Deleting a non-root Category reparents its Parts
Preconditions: A child Category exists with a Part assigned to it; a parent Category exists above it
Test Steps: 1) DELETE /api/part/category/{childId}/ with {"delete_parts":false,"delete_child_categories":false} 2) GET the Part that was assigned to the child category
Expected Result: DELETE returns 204; the child Category no longer exists; the Part's 'category' is reassigned to the deleted category's own parent (NOT null - verified live behavior)

Title: Category name boundary (maxLength=100)
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/category/ with 'name' at exactly 100 characters 2) POST again with 101 characters
Expected Result: 100-character name: 201 Created. 101-character name: 400 Bad Request

Title: Search Parts by name substring
Preconditions: At least 2 Parts exist with a shared unique substring in their names, and at least 1 Part without it
Test Steps: 1) GET /api/part/?search=<substring>&limit=10 2) Inspect 'results'
Expected Result: 200 OK; 'count' equals only the Parts whose name contains the substring; unrelated Parts are excluded

Title: Filter Parts by category
Preconditions: A Category exists with one Part assigned and one Part left unassigned
Test Steps: 1) GET /api/part/?category=<id>&limit=10 2) Inspect 'results'
Expected Result: 200 OK; results include only the Part assigned to that category; the unassigned Part is excluded

Title: Paginate Parts list with limit/offset
Preconditions: At least 2 Parts exist matching a shared search term
Test Steps: 1) GET /api/part/?search=<term>&limit=1&offset=0 2) GET /api/part/?search=<term>&limit=1&offset=1 3) Compare both pages
Expected Result: Each page returns exactly 1 result; the two pages return different Parts; the second page's 'previous' link is non-null

Title: Part list without pagination params returns a bare array
Test Steps: 1) GET /api/part/?search=<term> (no limit/offset) 2) Inspect response shape
Expected Result: 200 OK; response body is a bare JSON array (not the {count,next,previous,results} envelope) - documented InvenTree behavior

Title: Part 'name' boundary (maxLength=100)
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/ with 'name' at exactly 100 characters 2) POST again with 101 characters
Expected Result: 100 chars: 201 Created. 101 chars: 400 Bad Request, error references 'name'

Title: Part 'IPN' boundary (maxLength=100)
Test Steps: 1) POST with IPN at 100 chars 2) POST with IPN at 101 chars
Expected Result: 100 chars: 201 Created. 101 chars: 400 Bad Request, error references 'IPN'

Title: Part 'description' boundary (maxLength=250)
Test Steps: 1) POST with description at 250 chars 2) POST with description at 251 chars
Expected Result: 250 chars: 201 Created. 251 chars: 400 Bad Request, error references 'description'

Title: Part 'keywords' boundary (maxLength=250)
Test Steps: 1) POST with keywords at 250 chars 2) POST with keywords at 251 chars
Expected Result: 250 chars: 201 Created. 251 chars: 400 Bad Request, error references 'keywords'

Title: Part 'notes' boundary (maxLength=50000)
Test Steps: 1) POST with notes at 50000 chars 2) POST with notes at 50001 chars
Expected Result: 50000 chars: 201 Created. 50001 chars: 400 Bad Request, error references 'notes'

Title: Part 'default_expiry' must be >= 0
Test Steps: 1) POST with default_expiry=0 2) POST with default_expiry=30 3) POST with default_expiry=-1
Expected Result: 0 and 30: 201 Created. -1: 400 Bad Request, error 'Ensure this value is greater than or equal to 0.'

Title: Part 'units' must be a registered physical unit, not just a short string
Test Steps: 1) POST with units='kg' 2) POST with units='notarealunit'
Expected Result: 'kg': 201 Created. 'notarealunit': 400 Bad Request, error 'Invalid physical unit' - NOTE: this is a controlled-vocabulary check, not a maxLength check, despite the field metadata advertising max_length=20

Title: Nullable fields accept an explicit JSON null
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/ with 'name' set and 'keywords', 'units', 'notes' explicitly set to null
Expected Result: 201 Created; response returns 'keywords', 'units', and 'notes' as null (distinct from omitting the fields, which apply model defaults)

Title: Assigning a Part to a Category persists the relationship
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/ with category=<id> 2) GET the Part 3) GET /api/part/?category=<id>
Expected Result: Part's 'category' field equals the supplied id; the Part appears when filtering the Part list by that category

Title: Assigning a default_location to a Part persists the relationship
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/ with default_location=<id> 2) GET the Part
Expected Result: Part's 'default_location' equals the supplied id and is retained on subsequent reads

Title: Link a Part to a supplier Company via SupplierPart
Preconditions: A Company exists with is_supplier=true; a purchaseable Part exists
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/company/part/ with part=<partId>, supplier=<companyId>, SKU=<unique> 2) GET the created SupplierPart
Expected Result: 201 Created; response includes 'part_detail' and 'supplier_detail' embedding the linked records; GET confirms the linkage persists

Title: SupplierPart rejects a Company that is not flagged is_supplier
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/company/part/ with supplier=<non-supplier company id>
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request; error states the supplied supplier pk is invalid/does not exist (the API's supplier queryset excludes non-supplier Companies)

Title: Duplicate (part, supplier, SKU) SupplierPart is a conflict
Preconditions: A SupplierPart already exists for (part, supplier, SKU)
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/company/part/ again with the identical part, supplier, and SKU
Test Data: same {part, supplier, SKU} as an existing SupplierPart
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request; error states 'The fields part, supplier, SKU must make a unique set.'

Title: GET Part list without credentials is rejected
Test Steps: 1) GET /api/part/ with no Authorization header
Expected Result: 401 Unauthorized; error 'Authentication credentials were not provided.'

Title: GET Part list with an invalid token is rejected
Preconditions: Authorization header set to a malformed/unknown token
Test Steps: 1) GET /api/part/ with 'Authorization: Token invalid-token-value'
Expected Result: 401 Unauthorized; error 'Invalid token.'

Title: POST (create Part) without credentials is rejected
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/ with a valid payload but no Authorization header
Expected Result: 401 Unauthorized; no Part is created

Title: POST (create Part) with an invalid token is rejected
Preconditions: Authorization header set to an invalid token
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/ with a valid payload and an invalid token
Expected Result: 401 Unauthorized; no Part is created

Title: POST Part with an invalid field type is rejected
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/ with default_expiry as a non-numeric string
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request; error identifies 'default_expiry' as invalid

Title: POST Part with an unrecognised category id is rejected
Test Steps: 1) POST /api/part/ with category=999999 (non-existent id)
Expected Result: 400 Bad Request; error identifies 'category' as an invalid pk
